# Vudia

> Vudia is a software studio building focused apps for teams that work in Jira. Apps for Jira Cloud: estimation, default values, project cost and time in status.

Vudia apps are Jira Cloud apps built on Atlassian Forge and listed on the Atlassian Marketplace.
Vendor page on the Atlassian Marketplace: https://marketplace.atlassian.com/vendors/948520489/vudia
Support: info@vudia.site

## Apps

- [Poker ++ for Jira](https://vudia.site/apps/poker-for-jira/): Real-time Planning Poker inside Jira: secret votes, story points or time estimates, round timers, saved straight to Jira. Also called: Planning Poker for Jira.
- [Smart Defaults](https://vudia.site/apps/smart-defaults/): Pre-fill the Jira Create dialog with default values for each project and issue type.
- [Cost Tracker ++ for Jira](https://vudia.site/apps/cost-tracker-for-jira/): Calculate Jira project cost from logged time and hourly rates, and track it against budget and revenue. Also called: Cost Tracker by Vudia.
- [Time in Status + Gadget](https://vudia.site/apps/time-in-status-gadget/): How long every open issue has sat in its status, oldest first, right on your Jira dashboard. Also called: Time in Status Gadget for Jira.

## Atlassian Marketplace listings

- [Poker ++ for Jira on the Atlassian Marketplace](https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/36487747/poker-for-jira): Backlog estimation as a fast, secret-vote round. Cards stay hidden until the facilitator reveals them all at once, so the team sees where they disagree — and the agreed number goes straight into Jira.
- [Smart Defaults on the Atlassian Marketplace](https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/2494740556/smart-defaults): Set default values for the Jira Create dialog per project and issue type: priority, assignee, labels, components, versions, dates, description templates and custom fields, with dynamic values like {today+7} and {currentUser}.
- [Cost Tracker ++ for Jira on the Atlassian Marketplace](https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/2743016176/cost-tracker-for-jira): Cost Tracker takes the time your team already logs in Jira and multiplies it by hourly rates to get project cost. Add expenses and revenue, compare with the budget, and see profit for each project and across portfolios.
- [Time in Status + Gadget on the Atlassian Marketplace](https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/3362333248/time-in-status-gadget): Time in status for open work: how long each issue has been in progress, waiting in To Do or untouched, oldest first, flagged late or overdue against your team's own pace. A live dashboard gadget, not a history report.
